An '''ultrasonic scanner'''<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> or '''ultrasonic sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> that could detect ultrasonic vibrations.<ref name="TOR" /> [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] included an ultrasonic sensor, alongside [[Infrared receptor|infrared]] and [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensors]], which gathered information that was fed directly into his [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher]].<ref name="EGWT" />
